weights_mean: Total nonzero counts, independent signs; no plus/minus balancing
target: t(u)=(-A_T*u,0); optional mod-q centering must be retained
rotation: S(a)=(-a[n-1],a[0],...,a[n-2]); simultaneous signed negacyclic rotation of f and g
keygen_rejection: Only noninvertible f; at most128 attempts
historical_coordinate_partition: Sorted P; T is last kappa of surviving sorted f coordinates; C is remainder
pattern_sampling: Random coordinate subsets, not contiguous intervals
